intro: You wake up on a cold stone floor. Dim candlelight flickers across towering bookshelves. The only door out is set into the far wall, its handle replaced by a four-digit keypad. You must find a way out.

desk.description: A heavy oak desk sits in the centre of the room. Its surface is scattered with yellowed papers, and one drawer is locked with a small combination dial.
desk.examine: You sift through the papers — they are blank. The desk's only interesting feature is the locked drawer with a four-digit combination dial.

bookshelf.description: Towering bookshelves line one wall, crammed with hundreds of leather-bound volumes. Four books stand out — their spines are arranged slightly askew from the rest.
bookshelf.examine: You pull out the four odd books. Inside the front cover of each, a number is scribbled in faded ink: 7, 3, 9, 1. The order matches how they sat on the shelf.

painting.description: A large landscape painting hangs on the wall above the desk. The frame looks slightly crooked.
painting.examine: You lift the painting from its hook. Taped to the back is a small brass key and a scrap of paper that reads: 'For the drawer, if numbers fail you.'

drawer.description: The desk drawer is locked with a four-digit combination dial. There is also a keyhole beneath the dial.
drawer.examine: You cannot see inside the drawer — it is firmly locked.

door.description: A heavy oak door set into the far wall. Where a handle should be, there is a four-digit numeric keypad. A small red light glows beside it.
door.examine: The keypad reads 'ENTER CODE'. The door will not budge without the correct four-digit code.

brass_key.name: Brass Key
brass_key.description: A small brass key found behind the painting.

drawer_note.name: Folded Note
drawer_note.description: A note found inside the drawer. It reads: 'The door code is 2 4 6 8.'
